intent: To demonstrate the significant disparity in vaccine purchases between high-income nations and lower-income countries or international mechanisms like Covax.

requirements.question: Must the video establish High income as the maximum relative value?
Is the High income versus Covax ratio required, or is Covax's lower ranking enough?
Is preserving the full ordering required, especially Covax above Lower middle and Lower income?
Is the High income versus Lower income ratio required, or is the ranking alone sufficient?

units.claim: High income has the largest relative purchase level among all listed categories.

basis.note: largest relative_value in the table; no absolute value is available

accept: High income has the highest relative purchase level in the series, at 0.5353.
High income is the top category on the relative scale.
No other listed entity has a relative_value above 0.5353.
units.evidence: The relative magnitude for High income must be visibly greater than every other listed entity.

units.claim: High income's relative purchase level is about four times Covax's relative purchase level.
accept: High income's relative value is about 4.3 times Covax's.
Covax's relative value is roughly one-fourth of High income's.
High income is more than four times Covax on the relative scale.
units.evidence: The chart must make the relative magnitude of High income and Covax directly comparable so the roughly fourfold gap is visible.

units.claim: The full relative ordering is High income > Upper middle income > Covax > Lower middle income > Lower income.
accept: Order from highest to lowest: High income, Upper middle income, Covax, Lower middle income, Lower income.
High income is first, Upper middle income second, Covax third, Lower middle income fourth, and Lower income last.
Covax sits between Upper middle income and Lower middle income in the ranking.
units.evidence: The relative ordering of all five entities must be visually discernible.

units.claim: High income's relative purchase level is about fifteen times Lower income's relative purchase level.
accept: High income's relative value is about 15 times Lower income's.
Lower income is the lowest relative value, roughly one-fifteenth of High income's.
High income is more than fifteen times Lower income on the relative scale.
units.evidence: The chart must make the relative magnitudes of High income and Lower income comparable enough to show the roughly fifteenfold gap.

optional_valid: Covax's relative value (0.1253) is greater than Lower middle income (0.0535) and Lower income (0.0353).
Upper middle income is the second-highest relative value (0.1367).

g0_data_completeness.selection: all role=bar data rows; annotation rows excluded

clip_hardcase.reason: The reference SVG has no explicit data-role=bar mark, so visual-unit reconstruction needs manual review.

hardcases.handling: Requires human visual inspection before semantic scoring.
